111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}

117				_ = listener.Close()

119			}

189		}()

191		select {

193		case <-ctx.Done():
194			select {
195			case <-done:

198			}

All three insert these core fields: `uid`, `creator_id`, `content`, `visibility`, `payload`. Optionally `created_ts` and `updated_ts` if custom timestamps are provided (non-zero).

**`/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go`**, lines 122 and 130:

viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")
rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("driver", "sqlite", "database driver")

**`/bench/repo/store/db/db.go`** contains the factory function:

func NewDBDriver(profile *profile.Profile) (store.Driver, error) {

This is a simple switch on `profile.Driver` (a string). Any unrecognized value results in an error.
